Chapter 1: Bothild's Lode

At the end of a ravine in the misty Kummer Mountains lies Bothild's Lode, a vandalised dwarven mine flooded two centuries ago when greedy Bothild dug into an underground sea and loosed the White Death, a monstrous pale sea serpent that still hunts its freezing tunnels. Now the orc chieftain Maladûk has made the gatehouse her fortress, her goblins manning arrow slits above the entrance while she holds a war council at the old forge. Bothild's bored, vengeful ghost knows how to open her tomb but demands the serpent's death first. The heroes win by bargaining or fighting past the goblins, slaying the White Death, solving the door to Bothild's Rest without losing a hand, and perhaps forging an alliance with Maladûk against Azrahel Koth.
